description: This file defines an interface for providing environment statistics and a struct that encapsulates various system and process metrics such as CPU usage and memory consumption, with detailed comments and serialization attributes.

classes.name: EnvironmentStatistics
classes.description: A readonly struct that contains detailed statistics about the current process and environment, including CPU and memory usage metrics, with methods for formatting and calculating percentages.

methods.name: GetEnvironmentStatistics
methods.description: Method in the interface to retrieve current environment statistics.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Overrides the default ToString method to provide a formatted string representation of the environment statistics.
